reason: I do my own nails or use Shopee press-ons, and for the wedding next year I'd rather go to my own suki nail tech who already knows my hands. ₱1,800 for one set is a lot when I'm not even sure the wedding date needs it this month.
objection: I don't know this artist or her work yet, and ₱1,800 is way more than what I usually spend on nails. Why pay that to a stranger when my suki is cheaper and I trust her?
would_change_my_mind: A group package for the whole entourage at a lower per-person price, with real photos of past wedding clients, so my sister books it and we all get done together at home on the day.
